blocking_issues.item: Customer copy states a lab measurement as the real mobile experience: scripts/client_story.py:20 rewrites 'im mobilen Labortest' to 'auf Mobilgeräten'. It appears in every case, including the default legacy-baseline output, and violates references/client-storytelling-contract.md ('Customer wording stays inside the measured scope').
V08 shows minor-gap rows (value 0.75) as 'klar', while V10 calls the same 75 'Verbesserung sinnvoll'.
All 9 rendered cases are semantic QA FAIL; validate_deliverable_bundle --require-customer-release-ready exits 1 for each, and validate_release_gate exits 1.

required_revisions.item: Follow-up patch 'evidence-bound customer claims': keep the lab/field evidence class in customer copy; use one status scale for V08 and V10; bind strengths and chart suppression to metric ids instead of LEGAL_SURFACE_STRENGTH_TERMS keywords; add a deterministic validator for evidence-class and status consistency. This changes the default customer output and needs its own approval.
finalize_deliverable_manifest.py must downgrade a previously CUSTOMER_RELEASE_READY manifest when QA turns FAIL.
Page-level semantic QA must not be signed off by the authoring session alone; an independent reviewer is needed before PASS.
